[[File:AmeeBraces-TPM.png|thumb|200px|Amee wore a teeth implement.]]
A '''device''' was implemented by individuals on their [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. The device were known to be in use at least around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], during which the [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Amee/Legends|Amee]] from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] was known to have worn.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The device first appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> It later reappeared in the [[2015]] [[Canon|non-canon]] book ''[[Jedi Academy: The Phantom Bully]]'', written by [[Jeffrey Brown|Jeffery Brown]] as part of the ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Academy]]'' young reader series. In the book, [[Gaiana]], who is in her final [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the middle school portion of the [[Jedi academy]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], returns from [[Spring/Legends|spring]] break wearing the implement, identified as braces. Though [[Cronah]], a fellow student and school bully, teased her for it, none of the other students made an issue of it. [[Roan Novachez]], her boyfriend, comforted her by telling her that his brother, [[Davin Novachez]], had once had to wear braces.<ref name="bully">''[[Jedi Academy: The Phantom Bully]]''</ref>
